opus.problem: The cited verse (Numbers 22:5) says Balak sent messengers to summon Balaam at Pethor, but it does not say he asked him to curse Israel. That request is in Numbers 22:6, so this part of the clue is not supported by its reference.
A donkey the LORD made speak, asking why she was beaten three times, is the single most famous detail about this figure. It gives the word away on its own rather than being medium hard.
